product.name: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061
product.citation: Wan, Z., Hook, S., Hulley, G. (2021). MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061 [Data set]. NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center, Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA. https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD11A2.061. Accessed 2026-11-08.

scale_factor.note: already applied by AppEEARS: CSV values are kelvin

method.swing: day LST minus night LST for each 8-day record (difference of 8-day clear-sky averages from Terra, not a true daily max minus min)
method.lowest_temperature: lowest kept 8-day average LST (day or night)
method.mean_temperature: mean of all kept day and night 8-day LST values together (clear-sky only, two times of day, so not a true 24-hour mean)
method.units: K and degrees C; a swing is the same number in both
method.qc_rule: keep if QC bits 0-1 = 00, or bits 0-1 = 01 with bits 6-7 = 00 (average LST error <= 1 K); drop fill (0), out-of-range and all others

not_assessed: local observation time of each day/night value (view-time layers not in the file)
